results.content: Amid President Donald Trump’s record-low approval ratings nationally, a new YouGov/Economist projection shows the president's net job approval is negative in all but three states. According to The Economist and YouGov, more people disapprove than approve of Trump’s job performance in 47 out of 50 states and in the District of Columbia. The three states where the majority of respondents still approve of the president are Wyoming (+14), Idaho (+9), and West Virginia (+6). The lowest net job approval rating for Trump was in D.C. results.content: Even in Iowa, Republican candidates for the Senate and governorship are now locked in tight races, a new Suffolk University poll finds − thanks, in part, to dissatisfaction with Donald Trump in a state he carried in three presidential elections. In the governor's race, Democratic state Auditor Rob Sand is leading Republican businessman Zach Lahn by 4 percentage points, 48%-44%. In the Senate race, Republican congresswoman Ashley Hinson is leading Democratic state representative Josh Turek by 4 points, 45%-41%.
